examples.en: My father fishes at the river every weekend.
I went fishing at the sea yesterday.
Tomorrow I'm going fishing with a friend.

examples.ko: 낚시하는 동안 물고기가 한 마리도 안 잡혔어요.
examples.en: I didn't catch a single fish while fishing.
It's hard to fish when it rains.
I fished at the lake and came back home.

explain: '낚시를 하다'가 한 단어처럼 된 말이에요. '낚시하러 가다'는 낚시 자체가 목적일 때 많이 써요. 물고기를 실제로 '잡다'와는 달라서, 낚시하다고 해도 하나도 못 잡을 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I go fishing with a friend on weekends.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when fishing is the purpose of going.

phrases.example: 저는 바다에서 낚시를 해 본 적이 있어요.
phrases.en: I have fished at the sea before.
There are many people fishing by the river.
phrases.nuance_ko: 낚시를 하는 사람을 꾸며 말할 때 써요.

explain_en: This is '낚시를 하다' ('do fishing') turned into one word. '낚시하러 가다' is the common way to say you go out to fish. It differs from '잡다' (to catch): you can 낚시하다 and still catch nothing.

examples.en: Our team won this round.
The game went to the third round.

examples.ko: 골프장에서 열여덟 홀 한 라운드를 돌았어요.
examples.en: I played one round of eighteen holes at the golf course.
You need points to move up to the next round.
The mood was heated from the very first round.
I made a mistake in the final round.

explain: 게임을 하다가 '한 판 더'라고 말하는 자리에 라운드도 쓸 수 있지만, 입말에서는 '판'이 더 흔해요. 권투·골프·오디션처럼 단계가 이어지는 경기에서는 '3라운드'처럼 숫자와 함께 써요.

phrases.en: Our team came from behind in the last round.
phrases.nuance_ko: 단계가 이어지는 경기의 마지막 단계를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the final stage of a competition with several stages.

phrases.en: Who is in the next round?
phrases.nuance_ko: 오디션이나 대회에서 다음 단계를 물을 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used to ask about the next stage of an audition or contest.
In games, 'pan' is more common than 'round' in speech.

explain_en: Where you would say 'one more game' in everyday talk, Koreans usually use '판' rather than 'round'. 'Round' fits step-by-step contests like boxing, golf and auditions, and goes with numbers, as in 'round 3'.

examples.en: The child rides a tricycle around the park.

examples.ko: 세발자전거는 바퀴가 세 개라서 넘어지지 않아요.
examples.en: A tricycle has three wheels, so it doesn't fall over.
My nephew happily rides his tricycle around the yard.
The tricycle broke, so I fixed the wheel.

examples.ko: 두발자전거를 배우기 전에 세발자전거에 먼저 앉아 봤어요.
examples.en: Before learning a two-wheeled bike, I first sat on a tricycle.

examples.ko: 세발자전거도 이제 작아져서 아이가 못 타요.
examples.en: The tricycle has become too small now, so the child can't ride it.

explain: 바퀴가 세 개인 어린이용 자전거예요. 짝이 되는 말은 '두발자전거'이고, 두발자전거를 처음 배울 때는 '보조 바퀴'를 달기도 해요. '세 발'과 붙여서 한 단어처럼 써요.

phrases.en: I bought my child a tricycle for their birthday.
phrases.nuance_ko: 부모가 아이에게 선물할 때 자주 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used when a parent gives a gift to a child.

phrases.nuance_ko: 바퀴가 세 개인 점을 떠올리며 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits with the fact that it has three wheels.

phrases.en: Now I ride a two-wheeled bike instead of a tricycle.

explain_en: It is a children's bicycle with three wheels. Its counterpart is '두발자전거', and kids sometimes add '보조 바퀴' (training wheels) when first learning to ride one. It is written together as a single word.

examples.en: We did long-distance running in PE class today.
In long-distance running, you should start slowly.
I like sprints more than long-distance running.
My long-distance running time is better than last month.
After long-distance running, I drink enough water.

examples.ko: 우리 학교는 가을에 오래달리기 대회가 있어요.
examples.en: Our school has a long-distance running event in autumn.

explain: 학교 체육에서 많이 듣는 종목 이름이에요. 짧은 거리를 빨리 뛰는 '단거리 달리기'와 반대로 오래 쉬지 않고 뛰는 거예요. 한 단어라서 붙여 써요.

phrases.en: In P.E. class we did long-distance running on the field.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common verb pairing with '오래달리기'.

phrases.en: We have a long-distance running test tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교에서 체력을 재는 시험을 말할 때 써요.

phrases.en: My long-distance running record has improved a lot.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뛴 시간이나 결과를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for your running time or result.

explain_en: This is an event name you often hear in school PE. It is the opposite of short sprints, meaning running for a long time without stopping. It is written as one word.

examples.en: I took the last runner's spot in the relay race at the sports day.
Teamwork is really important in a relay race.
Our class came first in the relay race.
I fell while practicing for the relay race.
I was picked as a relay runner, so I'm nervous.
When the relay race started, the cheering got louder.

explain: 학교 운동회에서 가장 인기 있는 종목 중 하나예요. '릴레이'라는 외래어도 쓰고, 운동 경기에서는 '계주'라고도 해요. '이어달리기를 하다', '이어달리기에 나가다'처럼 말해요.

phrases.en: We did a relay race on the field.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic way to say you ran a relay.
Used when taking part as a competitor.

phrases.en: Our class won first place in the relay.
phrases.nuance_ko: 운동 경기에서 쓰는 같은 뜻의 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A synonym used in sports contexts.

explain_en: It is one of the most popular events at school sports days. The loanword '릴레이' is also used, and in athletics the term '계주' is common. You say '이어달리기를 하다' or '이어달리기에 나가다'.

examples.en: That singer's low notes are really cool.
Speaking slowly in a low voice sounds comfortable.

examples.ko: 이 스피커는 저음을 잘 살려 줘요.
examples.en: This speaker brings out the low sounds well.
My voice cracked on the low notes while I was singing.

examples.ko: 형의 저음은 깊고 부드러워서 라디오에 잘 어울려요.
examples.en: My brother's low voice is deep and soft, so it suits the radio.

examples.ko: 저음도 고음도 잘 내는 사람이 부러워요.
examples.en: I envy people who can sing both low and high notes well.

explain: '고음'과 짝이 되는 말로, 소리의 높낮이를 말할 때 써요. '저음이 좋다', '저음을 내다'처럼 말해요. 사람 목소리에는 '낮은 목소리'도 같이 써요.

phrases.en: It's hard to sing low notes when singing.
phrases.nuance_ko: 낮은 소리를 만들어 낼 때 '내다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: '내다' is used when you produce a low sound.

phrases.en: That person speaks in a low voice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람이 말하는 소리는 '저음'보다 '낮은 목소리'가 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: For a person's speaking voice, '낮은 목소리' sounds more natural than '저음'.

phrases.example: 이 노래는 고음과 저음이 다 있어요.
phrases.en: This song has both high and low notes.
phrases.nuance_ko: 반대되는 말인 '고음'과 같이 써서 소리의 차이를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Paired with its opposite '고음' to describe the range of sounds.

explain_en: It pairs with 고음 and describes how low a sound is. Typical use is 저음이 좋다 or 저음을 내다. For human voices, 낮은 목소리 is also used.
